title: kevware
features:
🎯 Aim Systems
Enable Camlock Master: Activates the primary tracking system to lock onto targets when pressing the [Q] key.

Smoothness Speed Modifier: A slider (scaled 1–10) that adjusts how rigidly or smoothly your view/mouse tracks the target's head.

Linear Dynamic Prediction: A customizable slider (0–300) that calculates and offsets your aim based on the target’s velocity vector, helping you hit moving targets cleanly.

Raycast Geometry Wall Check: A toggle to ensure the lock-on logic only targets players who are actively visible, ignoring anyone behind walls or solid map geometry.

👁️ Visual Elements (ESP Framework)
Global ESP Framework Activation: Turns the entire secondary drawing framework on or off.

Draw Dynamic Boxes: Renders clear structural boxes tracking around target character frames.

Draw Target Names: Draws the player names directly above their characters.

Draw Stud Proximity Data: Displays real-time numerical distance tracking (in studs) underneath the target players.

⚡ Performance & Utilities
FPS Booster: Cleans up map clutter instantly by destroying junk assets (like graffiti, movie projectors, police spawns, and duplicate assets) and drops rendering quality to raw levels to maximize game frames.

Bypassed Flight Toggle & Speed Slider: Lets you fly around the map using standard W, A, S, D camera vectors, with speed adjustments scaling up to 150.

Custom WalkSpeed Override: Bypasses default running restrictions to let you adjust your walking speed anywhere from 16 to 120.

Infinite Jump Engine Activation: Links directly to your jump inputs to let you leap continuously through the air without hitting a floor.

Noclip Velocity Physics: Loops through your character's parts to strip away collision flags, letting you phase through doors and solid walls effortlessly.

🛠️ Core UI Mechanics
Menu Toggle: Uses the [Right Shift] key to completely hide or show the configuration menu interface while playing.

Anti-Clutter Engine: Automatically deletes existing or duplicate GUI folders on load to keep your game running smoothly. added teleport stuff
